notes:
Half of all hits were recorded as 1 damage: the damage packet's modifier block was skipped two bytes too far, so for one of the two common hit layouts the meter read the hit counter where the damage should be. On the global service boss fights summed to exactly half the boss's health, no kill was recognised and nothing was uploaded; on Taiwan the same layout is mostly Brawler hits, undercounted since July. The layouts now match Aion2Flow and NotMeter, verified against live frames from both regions.

Enemy hits on party members are no longer counted as heals, and MP restores no longer inflate party healing. Deaths: a healer who never attacked now counts as a player, a death within 30 s of a kill is not charged to the fight already won, and your own attack after a death is a revive. Attack spirits and Ranger traps no longer sit in the party list. A refreshed buff keeps its timer instead of vanishing from the panel.

Boss countdowns round up like the game and the PC's clock is corrected by aion2t.com's clock; the timer table keeps counting while it refreshes. The meter leaves the screen alone while a screenshot tool is picking a region. A stranger's one-row roster packet is no longer taken for a party member.

New: Combat Assist - three small panels with your cooldowns, your timed buffs and the target's debuffs, each placed and locked on its own, showing only what you choose. Alerts can be text, tone or voice independently, on their own panel. The global service's five regions (Europe, NA West, NA East, Asia, South America) are in the settings and detected from your own character; Europe is the default. PvP mode: your damage dealt and taken per opponent and skill. Catalogues refreshed from the 9 September client patch.
